params.caption: 🎮 GameStop CEO slams digital-only games as GTA 6 launches without a disc As GTA 6 launches with no disc, GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen said the move to digital-only games hurts consumers, who should be able to sell or trade what they buy. He also hit out at 'code-in-a-box' releases, adding it has hurt retailers too. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 15:31 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: GamesRadar+ · IGN · Eurogamer 👥 @RockstarGames 💿 Physical or digital?
